findings.summary: overBudgetIterate returns early from onDeveloper without clearing state.developerRoundPending when an ordered reenter developer round exceeds its budget. The next round then takes the 'ordered round ran' path even though it is really an iterate round. Harmless in the common path; consider clearing the flag before the early return. Also the over-budget round's commits skip review and spend one of the max 2 iterations; worth stating in the docs.
